expected_observable_behavior.zh: 相对冻结的健康基准，转矩与伸出时间缓慢单调上升。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Torque and extension time rise slowly and monotonically against the frozen healthy reference.

ground_truth.en: Wear 0.06/1000h (ball screw) and 0.04/1000h (cylinder), about +17% / +12% over 120 days; no step changes.

expected_health_response.zh: 前期 NORMAL，后期允许 WATCH；不得因正常老化升级为 WARNING；自适应基线不得吸收老化。
expected_health_response.en: NORMAL early, WATCH allowed late; normal aging must not escalate to WARNING; the adaptive baseline must not absorb aging.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.

abstention_cases.zh: 无失效数据：失效概率/RUL 必须返回不支持（NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE）。
abstention_cases.en: No failure data: failure probability/RUL must return unsupported (NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE).

limitations.zh: 转矩升高只说明负载/摩擦变化，不能单独证明丝杠磨损。
limitations.en: Higher torque indicates a load/friction change; it does not alone prove ball-screw wear.
